title: Prism Quarry
short_description: Aim a glowing drill. Ricochet through crystals. Build your little quarry.
full_description:
Find the perfect angle. Make the whole cavern sparkle.

Prism Quarry is a one-finger arcade mining game about a small input and a satisfying chain reaction. Drag to aim your glowing drill puck, read the predicted path, and release. Bounce off the walls, fracture crystal seams and bring the haul back to your underground workshop.

ONE SHOT, A CRYSTAL CASCADE
Look for a clever ricochet through each chamber. Clear objectives, a visible shot path and forgiving opening chambers help you learn through play. Take in the final shot, bank your haul and try another angle.

TEN BIOMES, 200 CHAMBERS
Explore twenty chambers in each distinct region: Amber Hollow, Azure Grotto, Violet Vault, Copper Foundry, Jade Canopy, Frostglass Caverns, Ember Rift, Moonstone Archive, Obsidian Crown and Prismatic Depths. Familiar opening seams lead into a much longer expedition through new layouts, scenery and crystal arrangements.

BUILD YOUR LITTLE WORKSHOP
Choose among six upgrades with twelve ranks each. Keep the drill in flight longer with the Longburn drill, widen matching-crystal chains with the Echo lens, or improve the haul with the Salvage rig. The Focus tip gives more contact margin, the Prism resonator extends white-prism reach, and the Combo calibrator adds points to each crystal. Smaller ore payouts make workshop choices last across the expanded campaign. Every chamber is designed for base equipment.

A REASON TO RETURN
Earn miner XP, unlock cosmetic choices, take on a seeded daily chamber, complete daily goals, collect seven-day login rewards or head into Endless Quarry. Local achievements and records keep track of your progress.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Enjoy one-finger controls, music and effects settings, reduced-motion feedback and a clear pause option. Progress is saved locally. The Android edition includes ads at natural breaks and an optional rewarded continuation after failure. Online Google Play Games features require the service to be available and configured.

How much can you uncover with one brilliant angle?
